title: agent_improvement_candidate/v1
description: Schema for a single improvement candidate proposed by an agent-retrospective run. candidate_status is a closed enum whose transitions are constrained by the state machine in validate_retrospective_schema.py (ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS / validate_transition()), not merely by this schema's enum. Per ADR 0007 Decision 4 (mutation boundary), transitioning a candidate to 'accepted' and beyond, and creating an implementation issue, are remediation / control-plane mutations that require prior explicit human authorization; this schema only describes the shape of a candidate record, it does not itself perform or authorize any mutation.

candidate_id.description: Stable identifier for this improvement candidate.

candidate_status.description: Closed enum of candidate lifecycle states. Valid transitions between these states are enforced by validate_transition() in validate_retrospective_schema.py, not by this schema alone (e.g. 'rejected' -> 'implemented' is a value each individually valid but a transition rejected by the state machine). implementation_issue_created/implemented/validating/validated require implementation_issue_ref; rejected requires rejection_reason; superseded requires superseded_by (schema-enforced via the allOf/if/then invariants above).

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the candidate.

description.description: Full description of the proposed improvement. MUST be a schema-controlled projection (ADR 0007 Decision 6 allowlist model) -- not a raw transcript, and must not contain secrets, absolute local paths, or unredacted private GitHub content. This schema enforces the field allowlist only; value-level public-safety validation (secret/PII/path redaction) is Child 6's responsibility (ADR 0007 Decision 6, two-layer defense).

source_run_ref.description: Reference back to the agent_retrospective_run/v1 run_identity that produced this candidate.

implementation_issue_ref.description: Reference (e.g. issue number/URL) to the implementation issue. Required once candidate_status reaches implementation_issue_created or later (schema-enforced).

rejection_reason.description: Required when candidate_status is rejected (schema-enforced); explains why the candidate was not accepted.

superseded_by.description: Reference to the candidate that superseded this one. Required when candidate_status is superseded (schema-enforced).
